Mapping depicting Brampton Plan-Schedule 1A Town Centres & Urban Centres.
Town Centres are mixed-use focal points that serve surrounding communities by accommodating a combination of residential, commercial, institutional, recreational, and employment uses. They are planned to support growth, provide access to services and amenities, and function as vibrant, walkable destinations within Brampton’s urban structure.

Urban Centres are the City’s most significant growth areas, planned to accommodate substantial population and employment growth through high-density, transit-supportive, mixed-use development. As major destinations for living, working, shopping, learning, and entertainment, they play a key role in shaping Brampton’s evolution into a more urban, connected, and complete city.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
